description.text:
Shadow of Glory (暗影夺辉) was the fifth enhanced expansion (强化包) of the Sword & Shield series, on sale from 2 August 2024 in six-card packs with two holos, 20 packs to a box. Hisuian Zoroark V and VSTAR, whose VSTAR Power Ability swaps the hand for seven new cards, are on its cover.

It brought more Pokémon from Hisui, among them Hisuian Goodra V and VSTAR and Hisuian Electrode V, whose attack does 100 damage for each Special Condition on it; Regigigas, whose Ability works when all five of the other Regis are in play; the Radiant Pokémon Charizard and Blastoise; and the Stadium Gapejaw Bog. Its main cards are numbered out of 66; full-art, Special Art Rare, rainbow and gold cards run to 89.
